subject: Clearline — Throughput surge & RCA delivery / follow-through playbook
messages:
From: Asha Reddy <asha@clearline.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Jason Liu <jason.liu@clearline.ai>, ops@clearline.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden throughput spike & elevated 5xx — urgent

Ben —

We started seeing a sharp throughput spike on our production inference routes this morning around 02:30 PDT, followed by elevated 5xx error rates and user-visible latency. Impact was concentrated on our "/generate/longform" route; roughly 18% of requests failed and 27% were above our 800ms SLO for ~2 hours. This hit our peak traffic window and caused significant downstream queueing.

Can you share timeline and next steps? We need an RCA and a remediation timeline to present to our execs in 48 hours.

Attached screenshots from our side (ops logs) — happy to hop on a call now.

Thanks,
Asha Reddy
Head of Platform, Clearline AI

[attachment: ops-snap-20270621.png]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Sudden throughput spike & elevated 5xx — urgent

Team — forwarding Clearline's note. Quick triage notes from my side:

- Initial query shows a surge in concurrent long-sequence requests with a higher-than-usual avg token length (customer-side regen/looping).
- Serving runtime hit KV-cache churn + larger batch formation, causing higher GPU memory churn and a brief kernel fallback on a subset of pods.
- Mitigation applied (hotfix): pinned inference workers to a quantized variant and kicked problematic long-seq requests to a lower-parallelism queue; reduced errors but increased latencies for some tail requests.

Can we assemble a short RCA and a corrective action playbook for the exec readout? Prioritize: 1) customer-facing RCA PDF, 2) short remediation timeline, 3) permanent mitigations (routing policy + batching caps + model variant recommendations).

I can take the stakeholder update and own the exec readout; Kimberly, can you lead the remediation plan? Grace, can you collect the perf graphs and attach to the RCA. Karthik, we need an ops-level runbook update and suggested config for Dedicated customers. Marissa, loop in CS for renewal risk.

Ben
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

---- Forwarded message ----

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Asha Reddy <asha@clearline.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sudden throughput spike & elevated 5xx — urgent

Asha / Clearline team —

Thanks for flagging. We completed an initial RCA draft and attached a concise PDF that covers timeline, root cause, and immediate mitigations. Summary: the primary driver was an unexpected increase in long-sequence, high-temperature generation requests originating from a customer-side batch job that retried aggressively on transient failures. This produced unexpected token-length distribution that caused increased KV cache churn and a fallback to non-optimized kernels for ~14% of serving pods.

Immediate mitigations we executed:
- Applied a temporary routing policy to soak traffic to quantized variants for long sequences (reduces memory pressure).
- Introduced a short-term batching cap per-connection to limit batch sizes for the affected route.
- Rolled a kernel-pinning update on the 2 affected availability zones.

Attachments: clearline-rca.pdf; perf-graphs-june21.png; mitigation-plan.xlsx

Next steps (48-hour window) — owner: Kimberly
- Finalize RCA PDF and share with Clearline execs (today EOD).
- Provide a permanent config recommendation (batch caps, routing policy, model pinning) for Clearline Dedicated customers (target: 3 business days).
- Propose a follow-up regression test and a short canary for the kernel-pinning change.

Asha — will you confirm which Clearline job caused the surge (we saw user agent: clearline-integrator/2.1)? That will let us include the customer-side remediation ask.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Engineering Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

[attachment: clearline-rca.pdf]
[attachment: perf-graphs-june21.png]

From: Asha Reddy <asha@clearline.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Jason Liu <jason.liu@clearline.ai>, ops@clearline.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sudden throughput spike & elevated 5xx — urgent

Kimberly / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the RCA. The Clearline batch job you flagged is "ingest-transform-v2" — it retried on a transient upstream during the 02:10–02:45 window and generated a retry storm. We're running a hotfix to throttle that job and will add exponential backoff.

Two asks for your exec note: can you explicitly call out the actions we (Clearline) need to take and an estimated timeline for rollback/auditability? Also want to confirm host-level logs + request IDs for the affected time window (we can share with our SREs).

Asha

[attachment: clearline-ops-ids.csv]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Asha Reddy <asha@clearline.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Clearline — Exec readout + corrective action playbook (draft)

Asha / Clearline execs —

Attached is a short exec-facing one-pager and an internal playbook for our remediation and follow-through. High-level: Root cause = customer retry storm leading to skewed token-length distribution, which caused excessive KV cache churn and kernel fallbacks in a subset of pods. Primary impact window: 02:30–04:50 PDT on 2027-06-21.

Customer-facing asks (Clearline):
- Patch ingest-transform-v2 to add exponential backoff and retry caps (Due: 48 hours) — owner: Clearline SREs
- Confirm sanitized request IDs for audit by our joint teams (Due: 72 hours) — owner: Clearline Ops

Redwood mitigations / commitments:
- Permanent routing policy to bound batch sizes for long-sequence routes (Due: 3 business days) — owner: Karthik
- Default kernel selection safeguards for high token-length variance (Due: 5 business days) — owner: Grace
- Update Dedicated customer runbook and expose a per-route batch cap config setting in Console (Due: 7 business days) — owner: Marissa
- Credit: discretionary one week of overage credits offer while Clearline completes fixes; commercial team to finalize (Owner: Ben/CS)

We will include the host-level request IDs and sanitized logs in a shared Drive link by EOD tomorrow. Please confirm the timeline and owners so we can sync this into your postmortem and exec briefing.

Ben Carter
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

[attachment: mitigation-plan.xlsx]
[Drive link: https://docs.redwo.in/s/clearline-rca-D-92837]

If there are no further action items, we'll close this loop after the 30-minute walkthrough and verification that the routing policy is active for our tenant.

Thanks,
Jason Liu
VP Engineering, Clearline AI
